newsitem.title: USA: Iridium to launch 5 more satellites July 9.
newsitem.headline: Iridium to launch 5 more satellites July 9.

text.p: Iridium LLC said Monday it plans to launch another five satellites for its global telecommunications network on July 9, bringing to 17 its total number of satellites in orbit.
The satellites will be carried on a McDonnell Douglas Corp Delta II rocket from the Vandenberg Air Force Base in California.
The satellites are part of a planned 66-satellite network, to provide wireless telecommunications services anywhere in the world.
Iridium is a consortium of numerous companies, including Motorola Inc which directly owns a 19 percent stake, and Iridium World Communications Ltd.
